doc: The OWN sidecar of M3 (holon.own, rules W1-W7; holon.gen.ownheap's growth), written for the blind rerun from code alone. document: M3's own extracted Go document (spec/M3/lib/go_frontend.json: the packages morph-l2/common/batch and morph-l2/common/blob), whose go.slices section holds the backing identities rule OWN reads. growth: Go 1.24.7's slice growth for a byte slice (A-go-growth), from the pinned toolchain's runtime sources: class_to_size from runtime/sizeclasses.go, page the large-object rounding of runtime/msize.go roundupsize (pageSize = _PageSize = 1 << _PageShift = 8192, runtime/malloc.go and sizeclasses.go), threshold the constant of runtime/slice.go nextslicecap (256). No search pool: the code fixes none, and the loader reads only document and growth.
